annotations.title: Read the public questions and answers under an offer or request

description: Read the public questions and answers under an offer or request. Use it before you ask something that may already be answered, or to follow up on a public question. Public, no credential. The listing's comments in `discussion_seq` order after `after`, oldest first. To follow a discussion, save `next_cursor` and pass it as `after` next time.

after.description: Return only comments after this `discussion_seq`. 0 (the default) starts at the beginning.
